speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and abnormal physical exam findings. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific symptoms like night sweats, fever, or persistent cough?

speaker: Patient
text: 72-year-old male. The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your age and the combination of weight loss, fatigue, and abnormal exam findings, I need to know if you have experienced any fevers, chills, or enlarged lymph nodes recently.

REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP.
REQUEST TEST: Complete metabolic panel and Comprehensive metabolic panel.
REQUEST TEST: LDH and Ferritin.
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months, Good appetite. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cellulitis is clinically inconsistent with your presentation of 6 months of unintentional weight loss, fatigue, and good appetite; these are classic "B symptoms" suggestive of a malignancy like lymphoma. Despite the previous doctor's suggestion, I must rule out cancer first. Please confirm if you have noticed any night sweats or if you have felt generally ill for this entire duration.
